Project Overview

Engineering an Inspiring Experience

ICGC Christ Temple East is a landmark project that serves as the spiritual and community hub for thousands of worshippers.

Built Services Consult provided comprehensive MEP engineering consultancy services, ensuring the building delivers exceptional comfort, safety, energy efficiency, and acoustics to support a life-transforming worship experience.

View Project Gallery

Our MEP Solutions

Integrated. Reliable. Purpose-Built.

Mechanical Engineering

High-efficiency HVAC systems including chillers, AHUs, ventilation, and dehumidification for comfort and air quality.

Electrical Engineering

Power distribution, lighting design, standby power, earthing and lightning protection for uninterrupted operations.

Plumbing & Water Systems

Water supply, treatment, storage, pressure boosting, and efficient drainage and wastewater management.

Fire Protection

Advanced fire detection, alarm, sprinkler systems, hydrants, and voice evacuation for life safety compliance.

MEP Coordination

Collaborative coordination with architects, engineers, and contractors for seamless project delivery.

Acoustics & AV Systems

Acoustic treatment, sound reinforcement, and audiovisual systems for clear, immersive worship experiences.

Project Highlights

Built for Impact. Designed to Inspire.

  • Optimized HVAC for large-audience comfort
  • State-of-the-art lighting with smart controls
  • Superior acoustics for word and music clarity
  • Reliable standby power for zero downtime
  • Advanced fire safety and life protection systems
  • Efficient water supply and drainage systems
  • Sustainable systems for energy efficiency and long-term savings

Project Impact

Enhanced Worship Experience: Comfort, acoustics, and lighting designed to create a powerful and uplifting atmosphere.

Operational Reliability: Robust MEP systems ensure seamless operations for large gatherings every day.

Safety & Compliance: Full compliance with international codes and best-in-class life safety standards.

Sustainable Value: Energy-efficient systems that reduce operational costs and environmental impact.

Built Services Consult demonstrated outstanding professionalism, technical expertise, and commitment to excellence in delivering MEP solutions that support our mission and vision for Christ Temple East.
